Definition: **Active members**: Number of active members (all benefactor, gold, organizational, individual, and special type) of HL7 International.

**Event participation**: Event Participation YoY change = ((Current Year Event Participation - Previous Year Event Participation) / Previous Year Event Participation) × 100%. Here we include all "core" HL7 events that we host: HL7 International WGMs, FHIR Connectathons, and DevDays. This is calculated as a one year "rolling" average: 12 months prior to now = current year; 12 months preceding that = previous year. Other event participation (e.g. webinars, special events, joint meetings with other groups, board meetings, etc) is tracked separately, but not in this KPI.
**Published specifications**: Number of new specification (i.e. standards or protocol specifications) editions published by HL7 International.
**Issues resolved**: Number of specification feedback issues (as tracked in Jira for FHIR, CDA, V2 and OTHER product families) transitioning to a resolved status.

**Countries with national adoption**: Number of countries adopting HL7 specifications in their digital health initiatives including regulation, policy, government initiatives, or technical architectures as described here.
**Participants in HL7 courses**: Number of enrolled participants in educational courses (whether paid or free) delivered by HL7 International, HL7 Affiliates, and HL7 Educational Partners.
**Revenue variance**: ((Actual Revenue - Budgeted Revenue) / Budgeted Revenue) × 100%
**Expense variance**: ((Actual Expenses - Budgeted Expenses) / Budgeted Expenses) × 100%

**Membership income**: Membership income YoY change = (((Current One Year Membership Income - Previous One Year Membership Income) / Previous One Year Membership Income) × 100%. This is calculated as a one year "rolling" average: 12 months prior to now = current year; 12 months preceding that = previous year.
**Operating reserves**: Months of Operating Reserve = Unrestricted Net Assets (minus Fixed Assets) / Average Monthly Expenses

**Member satisfaction index**: Net Promotor Score measures member loyalty and satisfaction by asking a single question: 'On a scale of 0 to 10, how likely are you to recommend us to a friend or colleague?'. NPS = % of Promoters (9-10 ratings) - % of Detractors (0-6 ratings).
**Member retention rate**: Number of members at the end of the period - number of new members acquired % number of individuals at the beginning of the period x 100.

**Time to issue resolution: average**: Time from creation of issue to first transition to any resolved state (Deferred, Resolved - Change Required, Published, Duplicate, Resolved - No Change, or Applied). Calculated as average days.

**Time to issue resolution: median**: Time from creation of issue to first transition to any resolved state (Deferred, Resolved - Change Required, Published, Duplicate, Resolved - No Change, or Applied). Calculated as median days.

**Time to issue resolution: P80**: Time from creation of issue to first transition to any resolved state (Deferred, Resolved - Change Required, Published, Duplicate, Resolved - No Change, or Applied). Calculated as the 80th percentile of resolution time.
**Time to (resolved) issue being applied in specification**: Time from issue entering 'Resolved - Change Required' status to 'Applied'.

**Balloters enrolled**: Number of people (unique individuals) enrolled in any of the Consensus Groups. Derived from Jira, which does not include withdraw or reaffirmation, or other special ballots like GOM approval.
**Active voters**: Number of people who cast an 'active' vote (either Affirmative or Negative) in any of the Consensus Groups
**Active voters percent**: Number of people who cast an 'active' vote (either Affirmative or Negative) in any of the Consensus Groups out of all enrolled voters in the Consensus Groups.
**Active voters % per CG average**: Average of the % of Active Voters per Consensus Group across all CGs in the time period.
**Packages**: Number of packages available in the FHIR ecosystem. Most packages correspond to an IG. Sourced from packages2.fhir.org.
**Packages: new**: Number of new packages available in the FHIR ecosystem. Most packages correspond to an IG. Sourced from packages2.fhir.org.
**Package versions**: Number of package versions available in the FHIR ecosystem. Most packages correspond to an IG. Sourced from packages2.fhir.org.
**Package versions: new**: Number of new package versions available in the FHIR ecosystem. Most packages correspond to an IG. Sourced from packages2.fhir.org.
**Issues: new** (leading): Number of specification feedback issues created during the period.

**Resolved-to-new ratio** (lagging): First resolutions during the period divided by issues created during the period, as a percent. A first resolution is the first transition to any resolved state (Deferred, Resolved - Change Required, Published, Duplicate, Resolved - No Change, or Applied).
**Deciding backlog** (leading): Issues currently in Submitted, Triaged, Waiting for Input, or Deferred, among issues created on or before the period end.
**Application backlog** (leading): Issues currently in Resolved - Change Required, among issues created on or before the period end. These issues are included in the Doing stock.
**Deciding backlog age: median** (lagging): Median age, in days, of issues still in the Deciding backlog. Age is measured from creation to the period end.
**Deciding backlog older than a year** (lagging): Percent of the Deciding backlog older than 365 days.
